resume.name: Uday Pratap Singh Parihar
resume.headline: Full Stack Web Developer · React / Next.js / React Native · Node.js / PostgreSQL
resume.summary: Full stack developer with 3+ years shipping commercial web and mobile applications end to end. Currently **founding engineer at Akin**, where I built and shipped a React Native consumer app to the **App Store and Play Store** on an Express/PostgreSQL backend. Previously two years as founding engineer on a live B2B logistics platform, owning architecture, backend, dashboards and integrations. Comfortable with real-time services, cloud deployment, LLM-powered features, and reverse-engineering undocumented APIs when no SDK exists.

experience.title: Founding Engineer

Shipped event discovery and booking, digital tickets, location-based member discovery with maps, push notifications and **4 sign-in methods** (email/SMS OTP, Apple, Google); cleared **full Apple and Google store review** with EAS builds and **over-the-air updates**.
Owned the **Express + PostgreSQL** backend across an **18-table** schema (Drizzle ORM) plus admin dashboards, deployed as **Dockerized** services behind Traefik with automated migrations.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Shipped production features and fixes across **web and mobile** (Next.js + React Native), improving chatbot UX and reliability.
Built **agentic LLM workflows** in Dify orchestrating model calls with **BigQuery**-backed trade-data retrieval.
Delivered **rich responses** (text plus charts and graphs) by wiring workflows into the app's data and services layer.

experience.title: Founding Engineer
bullets: Owned the **full stack** as first engineer on a platform serving **9,000+ users** and **100k+ shipments**: architecture, REST backend and database design, auth and role-based access, and external integrations.
Shipped **client and warehouse dashboards** turning live shipment data into actionable views for non-technical operations staff.
Integrated **partner and carrier systems** under international shipping compliance; handled deployment, monitoring and production support.

projects.name: EHR Integration Layer — eClinicalWorks
bullets: Reverse-engineered **encrypted request payloads** and built a custom API wrapper from traffic analysis, enabling **UI-free** patient creation and appointment scheduling where **no public API existed**.

projects.name: High-Throughput E-commerce Automation — Myntra, Flipkart
bullets: Built restock/price monitors and a request-driven bulk checkout engine at **under 2 s per order and 500+ concurrency**, with a centralized dashboard on **GCP Cloud Run** and automated card payments with **3DS/OTP** handling.

projects.name: Field Operations Platform — FMCG distribution
bullets: ERP-style web app (invoicing, stock transfers, reporting) plus an **Android/iOS companion app** with push notifications and geolocation.
**Real-time** updates over Socket.IO, WhatsApp webhook and web-push messaging, Excel/PDF pipelines, and a custom ORM for a **legacy DBF database**.
